industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Alerion Clean Power S.p.A.
summary: Alerion Clean Power S.p.A. engages in the production of electricity through wind power in Italy. It has wind power plants located in Krupen, Bulgaria; and Comiolica SL, Spain. The company is based in Milan, Italy. Alerion Clean Power S.p.A. is a subsidiary of FRI-EL Green Power S.p.A.
